title: Fast assynchron typing into search box not possible
body:
When typing very fast into the search box not all chars are recognized! So when typing "test" only "tst" is recognized and triggered. 

Thought it might be related to #943 but when setting `urlSync: false,` typing is still delayed / syncron and not asynchronous. 

Window 7, Firefox 45, Internet Explorer 11

comments.body: Wow that is be very bad, can you give us the initialization and widget init code you are using so we can reproduce it?

Just to be clear, with this setup, you were able to have an example where when you typed "test", the rendering was actually "tst"?

Having a working example would help me a lot, thanks for the code example though. Do you think I could access your development website? (You can send it to support@algolia.com).
1.4.1 will be available on jsdelivr in ~30 minutes

Ok, much better now. But there is still a flickering at the moment when the hash URL is updated the cursor jumps forward and backwards and it seems that chars are lost at that moment. Not sure since I type "w"'s all the time. This seems related to the treshold thing. 

I tried to make a screen recording but it failed because the fps were not fast enough... 

---

I found something. I did tests with this [official Instasearch.js example](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/examples/media/) and Chrome and IE, they both work perfect when I hit and hold a key in the search field. Only my Firefox still had flickering. So **I restarted Firefox with all add-ons deactivated and no more flickering**! It might be that on URL refresh a antivir or addblock plugin/add-ons checks this "new" URL and leads to delay?!

> So I restarted Firefox with all add-ons deactivated and no more flickering! It might be that on URL refresh a antivir or addblock plugin/add-ons checks this "new" URL and leads to delay?!

Yes indeed if you have a lot of plugins it might be linked to them.
@powtac If you still have an issue linked to useHash: true please open a new issue, we might still have a bug here
